articles.company_name: Canada Goose Holdings Inc. Subordinate Voting Shares
articles.summary: Generated revenue of $274.0m, an increase of 5.9% (up 4.9% on a constant currency basis1) versus the prior year Delivered adjusted EBIT margin2 of (7.9)% compared with (5.5)% in the same period last year, primarily reflecting increased marketing investments ahead of the holiday season and our expanded store network, resulting in an adjusted EBIT2 loss and operating loss of $(21.6)m DTC comparable sales decline3 was 7.5% in the second quarter, reflecting lower store comparable sales, partially offset by positive e-commerce comparable sales growth in North America and Asia Pacific Maintained strong balance sheet and well-positioned inventory levels, with inventory turnover3 up 8% year-over-year at 1.0x sales Closed the sale of Baffin Limited, reflecting our continued focus on simplifying the business and on our key strategic priorities. As a result, the financial results are presented on a continuing basis, excluding Baffin discontinued operations, and prior periods are reclassified
articles.title: Canada Goose Reports Second Quarter Fiscal 2027 Results
